evidence.title: LivelyIcons — Animated React Icon Library with Motion
Documentation — Installation, Usage & API Reference | LivelyIcons

name: LivelyIcons
summary: React icon library of 1300+ SVG icons with built-in hover animations and 14 motion types.
description: An open-source React icon library with 1319 animated SVG icons, each a fully typed component. Icons ship 14 motion types (scale, rotate, pulse, bounce, draw, spin, ring, wiggle, heartbeat, swing, float) with four trigger modes (hover, loop, mount, inView) and respect prefers-reduced-motion. Install from npm; a CLI and an icon browser let you search, preview and copy icons or download raw SVG.
contains: 1300+ animated SVG icons (1319 in the icon browser)
14 motion types: scale, rotate, translate, shake, pulse, bounce, draw, spin, ring, wiggle, heartbeat, swing, float
4 trigger modes: hover, loop, mount, inView
CLI to search, list and copy icons from the terminal
React Server Components compatible via a /static export
